conditions.requires: JEM Security enabled on the dedicated server and a Forge right-click block event

change.summary: Verify a visible clicked face when the block-center ray would reject a right click

modifiers.before: JEM Security checks reach and physical obstruction toward the target block center, regardless of the actual clicked face
modifiers.after: Keep the existing server check for bounded native and assisted hits. When that check rejects, require the actual hit to be in reach and the server's outline ray to match the block, face and location. Require physical line of sight to the hit. Record the rejection reason in the existing audit

rationale.purpose: Allow a visible face to be used when another block hides the target center. Keep server checks for reach and obstruction
rationale.decision_source: The user reported intermittent placement failures and asked for compatibility with Luxium. The local audit confirmed server-side block-use denials. Forge 47.4.10 passes the bounded hit to the event
rationale.implementation_choices: Use the server's world shapes and player eye position to verify the reported hit. Retain previous admission for bounded synthetic hits from placement helpers. Keep lighting outside the security decision

introduced.summary: Use verified clicked faces for the dedicated server's right-click guard

history.summary: Add server-side face verification and identify right-click rejections in the existing audit

relations: Forge right-click block event supplies the bounded hit. JEM Security verifies reach and visibility against server world geometry
notes: The existing reach tolerance remains in effect. Break and attack validation, AntiXray and client attestation are unchanged
The guard uses no client mod identity or lighting settings for admission
unresolved: The original audit cannot distinguish which check rejected each click
Player acceptance for ordinary edge clicks and ProPlacer-assisted placement is pending
